Surgery is rarely used for PCNSL beyond biopsy, as the tumor is often diffuse and intertwined with healthy brain tissue. The standard treatment for PCNSL is high-dose methotrexate-based chemotherapy, often combined with other therapies like radiation or stem cell transplant.
